name: Chronic Cherry Berry Choice Chews | 200mg
description:
Relax and unwind with our award winning Choice Chew Cherry Berry gummies! We harnessed the untamed fruit flavor of one of Michigan's most prized specialty crops and combined it with the calming power of an indica to create the perfect marriage of flavor and feels. 

Made from scratch and infused with premium, high potency oil it's no wonder that Choice Chew Cherry Berry gummies are number one!
